output.title: ACME Certificate Profiles: feature depends on ACME issuer use
output.content: cert-manager is installed (v1.17.0) and the Certificate CRD (cert-manager.io/v1) is in active use in this environment. The ACME Certificate Profiles feature enables selection of certificate profiles when requesting certificates from ACME providers like Let's Encrypt. This change plausibly applies if your environment uses ACME Issuers or ClusterIssuers. Inspect your Issuer/ClusterIssuer resources to confirm whether ACME is configured and whether the new certificate profile selection would benefit your use case.
